Fixed: keep user in support_pending_users after sending so the dialog continues until /cancel or /start. /reply_ also re-adds the user as a safety net (e.g. after bot restart). UX text updated to set the expectation that the user can keep typing.

Fixed in handlers/admin_books.py:confirm_add_book — delete the prior 'Подтверждение добавления книги' message (works for both text and photo+caption) and send a fresh result message with '🔙 В админ-панель' button. Added await callback.answer() so the spinner clears.

Added is_support_active column migration in db/__init__.py; helpers set_support_active/is_support_active/get_all_support_active_user_ids in db/users.py; main.py hydrates settings.support_pending_users from DB on startup; new set_support_mode() helper in handlers/user.py syncs cache+DB on every change.
my_orders, about, main_menu, invite_friend callbacks now call set_support_mode(user_id, False) so navigating away from support exits the dialog and the next text message is not forwarded to admins.

cancel_action now reports exactly what was cancelled: current FSM state name, support dialog, and broadcast draft. Shows 'ℹ️ Нечего отменять' if nothing was active. Uses set_support_mode for persistence.
admin_reply_to_user catches TelegramForbiddenError separately from generic Exception; on hit drops the user from support mode (via set_support_mode) and tells the admin the user blocked the bot.

Added MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH=3500 enforced in process_description with friendly inline error; MAX_PAGE_PHOTOS=20 enforced in both photo and URL page-photo handlers; MAX_PHOTO_FILE_BYTES=9MB enforced before saving a page photo, so admin gets 'Telegram Bot API принимает файлы до 10 МБ' instead of a cryptic failure.

handlers/payments.py: replaced 42 print() calls with setup_logger() (debug/info/warning by severity). handlers/user.py: two remaining print() calls (web_app_data and orders error handlers) replaced with logger.warning. No more stray print() in handlers/.
